summary_for_children: Al-A'raf tells of Adam and Iblis and of messengers sent to their peoples: Nuh, Hud, Salih, Lut, Shu'ayb and Musa. Each people was called to worship Allah alone.
environment_concept: The heights: a garden with one tree (7:19), timbers of a ship on a hill (7:64), wide windy plains (7:65), homes carved in cliffs (7:74), a market where weights must be fair (7:85) and a calm shore (7:138).
architecture_and_scenery: Garden terrace, hill with a ship's timbers, windswept plain, cliff dwellings carved in rock, a market town, and a sea shore.

palette.lighting: Shifting light from area to area
palette.atmosphere: Wind on the plains, sea air at the shore

areas.name: Garden of the Tree
areas.description: A garden terrace with one tree not to approach.

areas.name: Hill of the Ship
areas.description: Timbers resting on a hill, recalling Nuh's ship.

areas.name: Market of Madyan
areas.description: A market where weights must be fair.

areas.name: Seashore
areas.description: A calm shore where the sea was crossed.

activities.name: Fair weights
activities.description: Carry the brass weights to the scale, giving full measure.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Walk the ridge
activities.description: Visit each people's area in order and hear the message they were given.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Each area opens with the Quran's own words for that messenger's call, then a short explanation.

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (ark, carved, market, sea, tree, wind) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
